newsitem.title: USA: USData Corp names Merry president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: USData Corp names Merry president, CEO.

text.p: USDATA Corp said Wednesday that it had named Robert Merry as its new president and chief executive officer.
Merry will succeed Bill Newell, who was named acting president and chief executive in March of 1997 to replace William Moore Jr, who resigned then to return to his consulting practice.

USDATA said Merry has served as president, process manufacturing strategic business unit, for Electronic Data Systems since 1995. In that position he was responsible for the company's $150 million process manufacturing business.
USDATA Corp is a global supplier of real-time application development tools, distribution management software, automatic identification equipment and related consulting and integration services.
